body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Email is Bounced in Saleshandy trigger (Zoho) on Production, all 5 activities:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one contact created with the mapped Contact Fields and one note "Saleshandy Email is Bounced". Existing contact with an old Title: the same contact is updated and no second contact is made. A real bounce (Send now to a real-bounce address) shows Bounced in Saleshandy and creates one contact with one note. | Pass |
| 2 | Create/Update a Lead in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one lead created with the mapped Lead Fields and the prospect company, and one note. | Pass |
| 3 | Create/Update Account in Zoho | Prospect with a company and no contact: account created with the company name and the mapped Account Fields, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Create/Update a Deal in Zoho | Contact with 2 deals: only the newest deal is updated and the older deal is unchanged. Prospect not in Zoho, Closing date 0: one deal created with the Deal Value as Amount, Stage Qualification and an empty Closing Date. No contact is created. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Task in Zoho | Contact created, then one task linked to it with the configured Subject, Status, Priority and the due date set 3 days ahead. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to send via npm run jira.
